submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires when the current token is a phrase-internal continuation of the constituent opened by the preceding 1-3 tokens: the second half of a split word (sym->phony, re->-election), a verb's object or determiner (believe->it, submit->your), a noun's particle (onions->to), or a subject's verb/copula (defendant->pleaded, France->is). Breaking the preceding context collapses activation even when the peak token is identical, while changing only the following token does not.
